items.name: Perplexity
items.why: Intuit partnership announced today (2026-08-31) implies partner-facing query volume and latency/cost pressure, paired with the strongest Reo signal in the set (High intent, 43 events / 12 developers). Partner status with a fresh enterprise-distribution trigger makes this the clearest this-week outreach window.
items.message: Aravind — saw the Intuit partnership announcement today. Integrating Perplexity into Intuit’s product workflows is a different serving problem than consumer search: higher predictability requirements, partner SLAs, and cost sensitivity as query volume scales. We build MAX, Modular’s inference engine, to cut latency and $/token for high-throughput LLM workloads without locking you to a single cloud or chip. If useful, I’d like a short call with whoever owns inference for partner-facing traffic—happy to share how teams in similar multi-product setups have tightened p95 and unit economics. Would 20 minutes this week or next work?

items.message: Michael — the reporting that OpenAI will cut Cursor’s direct model access looks like a real inflection for how you route and host models. Open to this week.
